name: LAPS / BitLocker Key Dump
description: Windows LAPS stores local admin passwords in Entra. BitLocker recovery keys are stored there too. Anyone who can read them can unlock a laptop or log in as local admin. That is a shortcut around the user's own password and around disk encryption. Helpdesk staff retrieve these keys for a reason. Attackers retrieve them in bulk. Bulk LAPS or BitLocker reads from a non-helpdesk identity are credential theft.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
